Indian Railways, Delhi Govt Announce Chhath Puja Services

Indian Railways has announced four special trains to facilitate travel during Chhath Puja 2026, with details on routes and timings to be provided. Separately, the Delhi government has declared November 16 as a public holiday for Chhath Puja, leading to the closure of government offices and public sector undertakings in the capital.
